headline.en: Restore a workspace to an explicit savepoint.
headline.zh: 把工作区恢复到明确的保存点。

sub.en: pitrrwnd provides the pitr CLI for snapshotting a directory of regular files, restoring a selected step and verifying the restored bytes against its manifest.
sub.zh: pitrrwnd 提供 pitr CLI，为包含普通文件的目录创建快照，恢复选定步骤，再按清单核验恢复字节。

body.en: Each savepoint has a step and label.
body.zh: 每个保存点有步骤与标签。

body.en: verify compares hashes and file membership.
body.zh: verify 比较哈希与文件集合。

body.en: Savepoints and audit artifacts live with the workspace.
body.zh: 保存点与审计产物保存在工作区。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Python 3 creates a complete temporary working set with two text files and runs the real recovery CLI.
note.zh: Python 3 创建包含两个文本文件的完整临时工作区，并运行真实恢复 CLI。

body.en: Python 3 creates a complete temporary working set with two text files and runs the real recovery CLI.
body.zh: Python 3 创建包含两个文本文件的完整临时工作区，并运行真实恢复 CLI。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/pitrrwnd.git
cd pitrrwnd
go build -o bin/pitr ./cmd/pitr

limitations.en: Recovery targets explicit savepoints. Arbitrary timestamp redo replay is not implemented.
limitations.zh: 恢复目标是明确保存点，尚未实现任意时间戳 redo 重放。

limitations.en: Snapshot traversal is not an atomic database backup. Stop concurrent writers when consistency matters; symlinks and non-regular entries are excluded.
limitations.zh: 目录遍历快照不是原子数据库备份。需要一致性时应停止并发写入；符号链接与非普通条目不在范围内。

limitations.en: Rewind overwrites and removes regular files under the selected root. The demo uses its own temporary directory. Local audit output is not a compliance certification.
limitations.zh: Rewind 会覆盖和移除所选根目录下的普通文件；示例使用自身临时目录。本地审计输出不代表合规认证。

body.en: A workspace can contain useful config and runtime files outside version control. A savepoint records those files before an edit, so a failed change can be checked and reversed within that chosen directory.
body.zh: 工作区可能包含版本控制之外的重要配置与运行文件。编辑前的保存点记录这些文件，让失败改动可在所选目录内检查和恢复。

body.en: The bbolt store indexes savepoints under .pitr. Snapshotting clones or copies regular files and writes a SHA256 manifest. Restore copies the chosen snapshot back and removes extra regular files; verify compares the file set and hashes. The optional watcher records file events in redo.wal, while audit records operations.
body.zh: bbolt 存储在 .pitr 下索引保存点；快照通过克隆或复制普通文件生成 SHA256 清单。Restore 把所选快照复制回来并移除额外普通文件，verify 比较文件集合与哈希。可选 watcher 将事件写入 redo.wal，audit 记录操作。

body.en: The bbolt store indexes savepoints under .pitr. Snapshotting clones or copies regular files and writes a SHA256 manifest. Restore copies the chosen snapshot back and removes extra regular files; verify compares the file set and hashes. The optional watcher records file events in redo.wal, while audit records operations.
body.zh: bbolt 存储在 .pitr 下索引保存点；快照通过克隆或复制普通文件生成 SHA256 清单。Restore 把所选快照复制回来并移除额外普通文件，verify 比较文件集合与哈希。可选 watcher 将事件写入 redo.wal，audit 记录操作。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: --root/-C chooses the workspace and defaults to the current directory. savepoint --label names a boundary; verify --step compares it; rewind --step applies it. .pitr contains state.db, snapshots, manifests, redo.wal and audit.jsonl. Linux attempts reflink and falls back to byte copy; non-Linux uses full copies. watch runs in the foreground and records events rather than creating savepoints automatically.
body.zh: --root/-C 指定工作区，默认当前目录。savepoint --label 命名边界；verify --step 比较；rewind --step 应用。.pitr 保存 state.db、snapshots、manifests、redo.wal 与 audit.jsonl。Linux 尝试 reflink，失败后字节复制；非 Linux 使用完整复制。watch 前台运行，只记录事件，不自动创建保存点。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
# Use a dedicated workspace directory containing your files:
./bin/pitr --root ./my-work init
./bin/pitr --root ./my-work savepoint --label "before edit"
./bin/pitr --root ./my-work verify --step 1
./bin/pitr --root ./my-work log
./bin/pitr --root ./my-work audit-export -o audit-bundle.tar.gz
